resources.string:
This app aims to provide travel information for fans travelling to the English Womens Super Leauge matches. All directions given in this app are taken from either maps or personal experience. The map view works in exactly the same way as the built-in map app on most phones, showing current location and allowing you to zoom in and out.

Please contact us if you think the directions are wrong or can provide clearer routes to the grounds.

Please note that the pub recommendations are just that, and we cannot be held responsible should any become home fans pubs without warning. If you have a good pub suggestion please contact us and we’ll add it to the next update of the app.

The fixtures are linked from www.bbc.co.uk/football, and the train information is linked from www.nationalrail.co.uk

This app will be updated to take into account promotion and relegation at the end of each season. This app is not affiliated with the FA, Womens Super League or its clubs. No club has provided any information for this app.

For more information see our website ejesoftware.com

To get in touch please use the contact form on the website.
This ground is not close to any National Rail Station. Please check the public transport section for other options.
